title: Sarbacher tells Strieber about Battelle materials

tellings.quote: Sam gave me Sarbacher's number and then he called me back and he said Sarbacher is waiting for you to call him. He's very eager to talk to you. So I call Sarbacher. Sarbucker proceeds to tell me all kinds of detail about the materials that he was dis was working on at the Battel Memorial Institute

plain: Sometime in the 1980s, a scientist named Robert Sarbacher described in detail the materials he had been working on at the Battelle Memorial Institute, a private research institute, according to a man named Whitley Strieber, who says he spoke with him by phone. Strieber tells Michels that a contact named only as Sam passed him Sarbacher's number and called back to say Sarbacher was "very eager to talk". If true, it would mean someone inside that research work was willing to talk openly about unusual materials.
